name: Metrics Delta Compare
description: Compare baseline and candidate states, return precision/recall/f1 deltas and significantly degraded samples.

baseline_states.description: Baseline states.json object. Can also pass a JSON-decoded dict.

candidate_states.description: Candidate states.json object. Can also pass a JSON-decoded dict.

sample_drop_threshold.description: Significant sample degradation threshold on f1 delta (default -0.05).
